notes.title: They fight... BUGS! - patch 1.01 is here
notes.notes:
[h1]The children of the night are out on the prowl… again! [/h1]

There’s still plenty of demon spawn for them to fight, but in [b]version 1.01[/b] they will encounter significantly less nasty bugs. These’re not the kind of imps we intended for the player to encounter. 

Thank you for all the nice comments we’ve received via all channels as well as for the constructive criticism. It’s nice to know you’re rooting for us - it made us really enjoy our time working to improve [b]From Shadows[/b].

Patch notes:
[list]
[*]Interdimensional portals leading to hell realms are tricky, but we’ve managed to improve the game’s stability
[*]Removed the experimental “mist mode” - in other words clipping issue with the character falling through the level floor has been resolved
[*]Some players experienced strange, “floaty” NPC behavior in the accelerated time mode in the tutorial - we’ve optimized the performance to prevent that from occurring
[/list]

Good hunting!
